title: Office link
description: The messages an office and a monitoring or management service exchange over the connection the office opens to it.
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @outstaff/protocol run docs:protocol`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Proposed** ([decision 0016](/decisions/0016-event-pipeline/)). Link version: **1**. The office link connects an office to a monitoring or management service, for example a dashboard. The office connects out to the service; the service never connects to an office. The service keeps no office data: it asks the office over this connection, so an office that is offline shows nothing. The messages are defined as schemas in the `@outstaff/protocol` package.

## Connecting

- The office opens a WebSocket to `link.url` from the team file, with the headers `Authorization: Bearer <OUTSTAFF_LINK_TOKEN>` and `Outstaff-Link-Version: 1`. A service that does not accept the token refuses the upgrade (HTTP 401 or 403).
- Messages are JSON text frames: `{ "type": "request", "payload": { ... } }`. A frame that does not parse is ignored; a request that does not, when its `id` can be read, gets an `invalid` error.
- The service sends `welcome` first. With another `version` the office closes the connection with code 4426. After the welcome the office sends `people`, then notifications as things change, and answers requests.
- Either side sends `ping` when it has been quiet; the other answers `pong`. The office closes a connection that stays silent for three of its ping intervals.
- When the connection drops or is refused, the office tries again with a backoff that doubles up to a cap. The link never holds up the office.

## Requests

The service sends `request` with an `id`, a `method` and its `params`; the office answers one `response` with that `id` and either `result` or `error`. Requests are answered in any order. A request the office cannot answer in time gets `timeout`. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; cursors are times, never ids.

Error codes: `unknown_method`, `invalid`, `not_found`, `timeout`, `failed`.

## Methods

### `people`

The people snapshot: each person, connected or not, with the item it works on and its queue in run order, each with why it is queued.

Params:

No fields.

Result:

| Field                          | Type                                                                                | Required | Description                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `at`                           | string                                                                              | yes      | ISO-8601 time, UTC.                                                                          |
| `people`                       | list of objects                                                                     | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].handle`              | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].name`                | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].role`                | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].connected`           | boolean                                                                             | yes      | Whether the person's agent is connected to the office now.                                   |
| `people[].counts`              | object                                                                              | yes      | How much work the person has.                                                                |
| `people[].counts.queued`       | integer                                                                             | yes      | Items waiting to run.                                                                        |
| `people[].counts.running`      | integer                                                                             | yes      | Items running now.                                                                           |
| `people[].current`             | object (id, kind, title, subject, startedAt, runtime, model, lastHeartbeat) or null | yes      | The item the agent is working on; null when idle.                                            |
| `people[].queue`               | list of objects                                                                     | yes      | Queued items, in the order they run.                                                         |
| `people[].queue[].id`          | string                                                                              | yes      | Id of the work item.                                                                         |
| `people[].queue[].kind`        | string                                                                              | yes      | What the item is, for example `assigned` or `review_feedback`.                               |
| `people[].queue[].title`       | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].queue[].subject`     | object (type, ref) or null                                                          | yes      | What the item is about: a ticket key, a pull request (`host/owner/name#n`) or a document id. |
| `people[].queue[].priority`    | integer                                                                             | yes      | Lower runs first.                                                                            |
| `people[].queue[].trigger`     | `human` or `agent` or `automation` or `schedule`                                    | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].queue[].reason`      | string                                                                              | yes      | Why the item is queued, in words.                                                            |
| `people[].queue[].scheduledBy` | object (policy, eventId) or null                                                    | yes      | The policy and event that queued it, when the event pipeline did; null otherwise.            |

Traces of the events the pipeline judged, newest first, filtered on the office, with the `total` that match. Page with `before` = `nextBefore`.

### `activity`

How much happened in each of the last few windows of time (default the last hour and the last day): events that happened and work items created. Exact, since the office counts them in its store.

Params:

| Field     | Type            | Required | Description                                                                          |
| --------- | --------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `windows` | list of integer | no       | Window lengths in seconds, each counted back from now. Default one hour and one day. |

Result:

| Field               | Type            | Required | Description                                            |
| ------------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `at`                | string          | yes      | The office's time of the count; each window ends here. |
| `windows`           | list of objects | yes      | In the order requested.                                |
| `windows[].seconds` | integer         | yes      | The window's length, as requested.                     |
| `windows[].since`   | string          | yes      | Where the window starts: `at` minus `seconds`.         |
| `windows[].events`  | integer         | yes      | Events that happened in the window.                    |
| `windows[].items`   | integer         | yes      | Work items created in the window.                      |

### `health`

The doctor checks: the ones the office runs at start, every day at `office.doctor.daily_at` and on demand, and the ones each agent reports when it starts. A failing check stays failing until a later run passes.

Params:

| Field | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `run` | boolean | no       | Run the office's checks now and answer with the result. A run that outlasts the request is answered with `timeout`; the `health` notification carries its result. |

Result:

| Field                | Type                     | Required | Description                                                                                                        |
| -------------------- | ------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `at`                 | string                   | yes      | ISO-8601 time, UTC.                                                                                                |
| `summary`            | object                   | yes      | How many checks have each status.                                                                                  |
| `summary.ok`         | integer                  | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `summary.warn`       | integer                  | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `summary.fail`       | integer                  | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `lastRun`            | string or null           | yes      | When the office last ran its own checks; null before the first run ends.                                           |
| `checks`             | list of objects          | yes      | Every check, failures first, then warnings, then the rest; by scope and name within each.                          |
| `checks[].name`      | string                   | yes      | What is checked, for example `Tools install`.                                                                      |
| `checks[].status`    | `ok` or `warn` or `fail` | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `checks[].detail`    | string                   | yes      | What was found, naming the value that is wrong.                                                                    |
| `checks[].fix`       | string                   | no       | What to change, when the check is not ok.                                                                          |
| `checks[].key`       | string                   | no       | The secret key the check is about, when it is about one.                                                           |
| `checks[].adapter`   | string                   | no       | The adapter that made the check, if one did.                                                                       |
| `checks[].scope`     | string                   | yes      | Whose check it is: `office` for the checks the office runs, else the handle of the person whose agent reported it. |
| `checks[].firstSeen` | string                   | yes      | When the check first reported this status.                                                                         |
| `checks[].lastSeen`  | string                   | yes      | When a run last reported the check.                                                                                |

## Messages

### `welcome`

First message after the service accepts the connection: which office this is. The office answers requests and sends notifications only after it.

Sent by: the service.

| Field         | Type    | Required | Description                        |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `version`     | integer | yes      | LINK_VERSION the service speaks.   |
| `office`      | object  | yes      | How the service knows this office. |
| `office.id`   | string  | yes      |                                    |
| `office.name` | string  | no       |                                    |

### `hello`

Sent right after the `welcome`: the office's team, version and pipeline mode.

Sent by: the office.

| Field                 | Type                        | Required | Description                         |
| --------------------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `office`              | object                      | yes      | Which office this is.               |
| `office.team`         | string                      | yes      | The team's name from its team file. |
| `office.version`      | string                      | yes      | The office's version.               |
| `office.pipelineMode` | `off` or `shadow` or `live` | yes      | `office.pipeline`.                  |

### `request`

Asks the office for data; see Methods. Answered by one `response` with the same `id`.

Sent by: the service.

The fields depend on the method; see Methods.

### `response`

The answer to a `request`: its `result`, or an `error`.

Sent by: the office.

The fields depend on the method; see Methods.

### `people`

Every person with the item it works on and its queue, as the `people` method gives it. Sent when the welcome comes and whenever it changes, at most about once a second.

Sent by: the office.

| Field                          | Type                                                                                | Required | Description                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `at`                           | string                                                                              | yes      | ISO-8601 time, UTC.                                                                          |
| `people`                       | list of objects                                                                     | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].handle`              | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].name`                | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].role`                | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].connected`           | boolean                                                                             | yes      | Whether the person's agent is connected to the office now.                                   |
| `people[].counts`              | object                                                                              | yes      | How much work the person has.                                                                |
| `people[].counts.queued`       | integer                                                                             | yes      | Items waiting to run.                                                                        |
| `people[].counts.running`      | integer                                                                             | yes      | Items running now.                                                                           |
| `people[].current`             | object (id, kind, title, subject, startedAt, runtime, model, lastHeartbeat) or null | yes      | The item the agent is working on; null when idle.                                            |
| `people[].queue`               | list of objects                                                                     | yes      | Queued items, in the order they run.                                                         |
| `people[].queue[].id`          | string                                                                              | yes      | Id of the work item.                                                                         |
| `people[].queue[].kind`        | string                                                                              | yes      | What the item is, for example `assigned` or `review_feedback`.                               |
| `people[].queue[].title`       | string                                                                              | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].queue[].subject`     | object (type, ref) or null                                                          | yes      | What the item is about: a ticket key, a pull request (`host/owner/name#n`) or a document id. |
| `people[].queue[].priority`    | integer                                                                             | yes      | Lower runs first.                                                                            |
| `people[].queue[].trigger`     | `human` or `agent` or `automation` or `schedule`                                    | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `people[].queue[].reason`      | string                                                                              | yes      | Why the item is queued, in words.                                                            |
| `people[].queue[].scheduledBy` | object (policy, eventId) or null                                                    | yes      | The policy and event that queued it, when the event pipeline did; null otherwise.            |

### `item`

A work item was queued or its status changed, with what a list of items shows (title, subject, kind, person, status), so a service can patch its list without asking.

Sent by: the office.

| Field       | Type                                                                   | Required | Description                                                                                  |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`        | string                                                                 | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `person`    | string                                                                 | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `kind`      | string                                                                 | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `title`     | string                                                                 | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `subject`   | object (type, ref) or null                                             | yes      | What the item is about: a ticket key, a pull request (`host/owner/name#n`) or a document id. |
| `status`    | `queued` or `active` or `waiting` or `done` or `blocked` or `canceled` | yes      |                                                                                              |
| `updatedAt` | string                                                                 | yes      | ISO-8601 time, UTC.                                                                          |

### `health`

The doctor checks, as the `health` method gives them. Sent when the welcome comes and whenever a check is added, removed or changes, not when a run only confirms them.

Sent by: the office.

| Field                | Type                     | Required | Description                                                                                                        |
| -------------------- | ------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `at`                 | string                   | yes      | ISO-8601 time, UTC.                                                                                                |
| `summary`            | object                   | yes      | How many checks have each status.                                                                                  |
| `summary.ok`         | integer                  | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `summary.warn`       | integer                  | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `summary.fail`       | integer                  | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `lastRun`            | string or null           | yes      | When the office last ran its own checks; null before the first run ends.                                           |
| `checks`             | list of objects          | yes      | Every check, failures first, then warnings, then the rest; by scope and name within each.                          |
| `checks[].name`      | string                   | yes      | What is checked, for example `Tools install`.                                                                      |
| `checks[].status`    | `ok` or `warn` or `fail` | yes      |                                                                                                                    |
| `checks[].detail`    | string                   | yes      | What was found, naming the value that is wrong.                                                                    |
| `checks[].fix`       | string                   | no       | What to change, when the check is not ok.                                                                          |
| `checks[].key`       | string                   | no       | The secret key the check is about, when it is about one.                                                           |
| `checks[].adapter`   | string                   | no       | The adapter that made the check, if one did.                                                                       |
| `checks[].scope`     | string                   | yes      | Whose check it is: `office` for the checks the office runs, else the handle of the person whose agent reported it. |
| `checks[].firstSeen` | string                   | yes      | When the check first reported this status.                                                                         |
| `checks[].lastSeen`  | string                   | yes      | When a run last reported the check.                                                                                |

### `ping`

Checks that the other side is there; answer with `pong`.

Sent by: either side.

No fields.

### `pong`

Answers `ping`.

Sent by: either side.

No fields.
